confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bucharest price levels, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderate confidence; accommodation anchors are less certain because July rates and included taxes or fees vary. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from their local relationship to the beer anchor (about 2.8x and 1.5x) because direct price knowledge is weaker. Local prices were reasoned in lei and converted at an approximate rate, so USD values carry some FX uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with mid-sized Central and Southeast European capitals with similar tourism demand and price levels, such as Sofia and Budapest, adjusted for Bucharest's generally lower restaurant and hotel prices relative to Western EU capitals.
